title: Tool Angel
description: Say goodbye to your favorite items ever breaking!
body:
![thumbnail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6732534091828bddfaea6b2db7757dfa6e8b16d9_0.webp)
# ⚔️🪽 Tool Angel
Tool Angel is a Minecraft Mod **currently only for Fabric** which protects your favorite precious tools from breaking, preventing unnecessary heart attacks over item durability, and more!\
Here are the main features:
## 🛡️ Protect your Items!
Favorite an tool using the _Favorite Tool_ keybind\
You can set a durability limit, and once it's past that limit it will stop you from using it accidently. But don't worry, you can also set a _warning limit_ that will warn you in advance will a tool starts to break!
### 🟡 Favoriting Armor
When favoriting armor it won't stop you from using it when it gets past the durability limit, instead **it will only send you a warning**
## 🟢 Know your durability without even having to look at the Tooltip!
Always having constant panic attacks over thinking you will loose your oh so precious, _netherite_ tools? Well not anymore! Items have a customizable glow behind their slot in your inventory or hotbar that can dynamicly change color to your item's durability.
## 💻 Armor Display
No more having to open your inventory to check your armor durability! You can see the durability of any armor you have equipped _( including elytras )_ at any time!

## 🔴 Dependences
- Requries [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- Requires [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)\
  [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is _reccomended_, but not needed

### ⚠️ Warning
**This mod doesn't work with most modded tools,** so be aware that the mod can suddenly stop working or **crash** your game with trying to deal with modded tools.\
Also this is one of my first mods so there might be a lot of bugs, sorry!
